llm.summary: This is a local browser note tool with proportionate local storage, though its documentation should be clearer that the manual update check contacts ClawHub.

dimensions.detail: Using localStorage and IndexedDB for notes, images, and uploaded files fits the app purpose; users should understand that selected local files and clipboard content persist in the browser profile.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No dependency install, background service, or executable installer is present; the packaging command is a disclosed optional distribution step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill trigger language is broad and includes packaging HTML into a skill, which could cause over-selection, but it does not grant hidden runtime authority or instruct unsafe agent behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to browser localStorage and IndexedDB with visible user controls; there is no evidence of privilege escalation, credential access, background workers, or automatic startup.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently implement a single-file note, image, file-folder, and Word-export browser app; the only mismatch is that documentation claims no networking while the page includes a user-triggered update check.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a browser-local note app storing pasted text, images, and uploaded files in localStorage/IndexedDB. Avoid clicking the update check if you require strictly offline behavior, because that control contacts clawhub.ai.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Verified a fetch to clawhub.ai exists, but it is reachable through visible update controls rather than running automatically on page load; this is an under-disclosure issue, not evidence of exfiltration.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The network path is not needed for note capture or export, but it is narrowly used for version metadata and does not send stored notes, images, files, or credentials in the artifact code.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The frontmatter description is broad and includes an HTML-to-skill packaging use case; this is a routing clarity concern, not a high-impact capability by itself.
[SQP-1] expected: The usage section matches the note-collection and local archive purpose, though it lacks explicit exclusions for unrelated requests.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The artifact does not prominently document that update checking contacts clawhub.ai, but the fetch is tied to user interaction with the update button or version label.
